transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I came in because… I keep thinking it would be better if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes I feel like dying would be a fair punishment for what I’ve done to my family and my crew.
Have you experienced a traumatic event that still deeply affects you?
I’m not sure. I mean, nothing specific comes to mind that I’d call a traumatic event. I’ve had hard things happen, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable and not like your usual self?
I don’t know. I can’t really think of a time where I felt unusually high or energized like that. Irritable, sure, I get irritable, but I’m not sure it was a whole period where I wasn’t myself.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Yes. I hear a man’s voice sometimes, like it’s coming from behind me. It happens at job sites, and sometimes in my kitchen. He’ll say things like, “You missed it,” or “Everyone knows.” It sounds clear, like someone is standing right there, but when I turn around, nobody’s there.
Have there been times when you heard that voice even when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes. There was a stretch for a few weeks where I wasn’t as depressed, I guess. I was getting up, eating a little better, not crying all day like before. But I still heard the voice at work, and I still felt sure clients and suppliers were tracking me.
Have you found yourself talking much less than usual, even when you want to say more?

Yeah. I don’t talk much anymore. Even when I want to say something, it’s like it doesn’t come out. My face feels blank, and unless someone really pushes me, I mostly just sit there quiet. Even with my husband or the crew, I feel like I’m behind glass, just not really able to join in.
Do you believe that clients or suppliers are actually tracking you?

Yes. I know it sounds strange, but I do believe they are. Even when I’m not crying or stuck in bed, I get sure the homeowners and suppliers are watching me through things like the floor patterns, the texts, and permit calls. It feels like they’re checking if I’m ruining jobs on purpose. People try to tell me that’s not happening, but I can’t really believe them.
Have people told you that your speech becomes hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

Yes. People tell me I’m not making sense sometimes. Like if I’m trying to explain what happened on a job, I’ll start talking about the tile lines, then my husband’s back brace, then license paperwork. In my head it all connects, but they say I’m not answering the question.
For at least one month, have the voice and the belief that people were tracking you been present most days?
Yes. It’s been most days for a long time now… around eleven months, I think. The voices and the feeling that people are tracking me through the jobs or messages haven’t really gone away.
Have you ever had a time when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had a time where I barely slept and felt full of energy. My sleep gets messed up, but I usually feel worn out, not energized.
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt people were tracking you, but you were not depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes. There was a stretch for a few weeks where I wasn’t crying all day like before. I was getting up, eating a little better, kind of functioning more. But I was still hearing the voice at work, and I still felt sure that clients and suppliers were tracking me.
During these past eleven months, have you been depressed for most of that time?

Yes. Most of the time, I’ve been depressed. Some weeks weren’t as crushing, but the guilt, being exhausted, not caring about things, and thoughts about death… those have been there through most of it.
Have the voice and the feeling that people were tracking you been going on for at least six months?
Yes. It’s been about eleven months now. The voice and the feeling that people are tracking me through jobs and messages… that’s been going on most of this whole time.
During that stretch when you were not depressed, did the voice and the feeling of being tracked continue for at least one month?

Yes, it did. During those several weeks when I was doing a little better—getting up, eating better, not crying all day—the voice was still there at work, and I still believed clients and suppliers were tracking me.
When the voices and the feeling of being tracked continued during that better stretch, were you completely free of depression then?

Not completely, no. I was doing better for several weeks—getting up, eating a little better, not crying all day—but I wouldn’t say I was totally free of depression. And during that time, I still heard the voice at work and still felt sure the clients and suppliers were tracking me.
Over these past eleven months, have you been depressed for more than half of the time?

Yes. I’d say definitely more than half. Most of the time since this started, I’ve had that guilt and exhaustion, and I haven’t really been interested in things. The thoughts about death have been there too… some weeks weren’t as crushing, but it’s mostly been there.
During the entire time since the voices and feeling of being tracked began, have your depression symptoms been present for most of that time?

Yes. Most of the time since it started, the depression has been there — the guilt, being exhausted, not caring about things, and the thoughts about death. Some weeks were a little less crushing, but it’s been there for most of it.
